title: County worker vacancies and HR consultant review
summary: A commissioner said on October 8 that urgent work lies ahead on vacancies, recruitment, retention and HR reform. The acting director said the department has had more staff turnover than usual and that the county does not do enough exit interviews to learn why employees leave. A consultant's review of recruitment and hiring, classification, and reorganization has done 46 interviews, with 20 more scheduled.
